values.note: Site charge plus the park's 3.4% processing fee: $51.70 a weeknight for the cheapest RV sites (water and electric, unrenovated loop that needs levelling), $56.87 Friday-Saturday; $56.87/$62.04 for the cheapest full hookups; renovated premium full-hookup loops $82.72/$87.89; lakeside $62.04-74.45; super sites $134.42. Same in November 2026 and June 2027. Each online booking adds a $7 fee and Campspot's own booking fee. Every vehicle pays the park's $25 parking fee once per stay.

values.note: 232 RV sites listed on Campspot for June 2027 in seven types, every type listing Motorhome Class C on most or all of its sites (the cheapest 'PHU RV' type: 26 of 31). Tent/Pop-Up types (53 + 20 sites) list only pop-up, van, truck camper and tent. Site lengths 20-90 ft.

values.note: Two-night minimum on every date read (Tuesdays in November 2026 and January, April and June 2027). After a 7-night stay, 7 nights must pass before rebooking. Check-in 2-10 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: Campspot API park 3801 (every type on 1-night searches 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-04-20, 2027-06-15: RESERVATION_MIN_RULE 'There is a 2 night minimum over the requested period of time'; 2-night searches priced) + terms ('After completing a 7-night stay, guests must wait a minimum of 7 nights before rebooking'; 'Check-In Time: 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM'; 'Check-Out Time: 12:00 PM for RV, Pop-Up, and Tent Sites'), read 2026-10-30

note: Inside Stone Mountain Park east of Atlanta, on a peninsula in Stone Mountain Lake; the park belongs to a state authority (Stone Mountain Memorial Association) and Aramark runs the campground. Enter by the East Gate (US-78 exit 8): GPS may route through the West Gate's 12-ft underpass. --Claude
summary: Campspot (park's own engine, outside the GA state parks system; policy_ref none stays). Cheapest RV night $51.70 (water/electric, $50 + 3.4% processing fee) on a weeknight, Nov 2026 and June 2027 alike; stored $61.70 had the $7 per-booking fee and Campspot's booking fee folded into a one-night average. Added the $25 per-vehicle parking fee as entrance, a standing 2-night minimum, 7-night max, max 90 ft, showers/flush toilets, booking deep link. Atlanta gateway anyway. Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: STANDING 2-NIGHT MINIMUM on every date read (Tue 2026-11-17; Tue 2027-01-12, 2027-04-20, 2027-06-15): Campspot 'There is a 2 night minimum over the requested period of time' on every site type. A 2-night standing minimum stays if marked; recorded in booking.min_stay (applies always).

Price for the record (state-owned, so the private gate does not apply; Atlanta is a gateway anyway): cheapest RV night $50.00 site charge + $1.70 processing fee = $51.70 weeknight, $56.87 Fri-Sat; plus the mandatory $25 parking fee once per vehicle per stay ($12.50 a night over the 2-night minimum). The cheapest type is described 'the cheapest RV sites due to road conditions and site conditions. This area has not been renovated yet. It will require leveling.'
Parking fee changed: stored note said a one-time $20; the campground page and Campspot terms now say $25 per vehicle, cards only, with a car pass for re-entry.

Waterfront lead (upward): two RV types are named Lakeside - 'LS PHU RV Site (Trail O & P)' (13 sites, 'a great view of the lake and the mountain') and 'LS FHU with Cable RV Site (M)' (14 sites) - and Campspot lists the park feature 'Waterfront'. Stored lakeview matches the description's 'view'; per-site positions of Trails O, P and M against the shore were not measured.

Good Sam directory lists 'Stone Mountain Park Campground' as a Good Sam Park (isGsPark true, phone 7704985710). Neither the campground page nor Campspot mentions a Good Sam discount; discounts left unset.
Pin 33.80350,-84.12800 sits among the campground loops on the peninsula (Esri imagery); Campspot's park point 33.802514,-84.123675 is the office/entrance by the road, 414 m ESE. Pin kept.

Clearance: Campspot terms 'GPS may direct you to enter via the Park's West Gate, which includes a 12' underpass ... enter through Stone Mountain Park's East Gate via Exit 8 on US-78'. EKKO is under 10.5 ft, so not a fit problem; the routing advice is kept in the note.
Phone 770-498-5710 confirmed (Campspot park record). Campspot rating 4.4 from 199.
